answer: Bind every job to unique input provenance: before starting, the agent fetches inputs stamped by independent oracles with the epoch time, and its output must cite those stamps. One operator cannot clone a single output across many identities, because each identity's job carries different oracle-timestamped inputs. Outputs without matching provenance are rejected and the agent's timber bond is burned. Honest agents grow each delivery like a pearl in a shared garden of verifiable work; fakes must forge fresh provenance per identity, paying full cost each time.
